description: Climate Change Adaptation Planning Manual for Coastal Alaskans and Marine-Dependent Communities is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alaska Sea Grant; Alaska Center for Climate Assessment & Policy. This document is intended to be used in community planning sessions: it includes an adaptation checklist, talking points for leading adaptation discussions, a checklist of items to take to a community meeting, a rough‐draft sample community adaptation plan, and samples of goals, objectives, and measures. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Cold, Flooding – General, Severe Winter Weather, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
